snp1.4:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā magadhesu viharati dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ ekanāḷāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme.
snp1.4:1.3: tena kho pana samayena kasibhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa pañcamattāni naṅgalasatāni payuttāni honti vappakāle.
snp1.4:1.4: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena kasibhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa kammanto tenupasaṅkami.
snp1.4:1.5: tena kho pana samayena kasibhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa parivesanā vattati.
snp1.4:1.6: atha kho bhagavā yena parivesanā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
snp1.4:2.1: addasā kho kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ piṇḍāya ṭhitaṃ
snp1.4:2.3: ahaṃ kho samaṇa kasāmi ca vappāmi ca kasitvā ca vappitvā ca bhuñjāmi.
snp1.4:2.4: tvampi samaṇa kasassu ca vappassu ca kasitvā ca vappitvā ca bhuñjāhīti.
snp1.4:3.1: ahampi kho brāhmaṇa kasāmi ca vappāmi ca kasitvā ca vappitvā ca bhuñjāmīti.
snp1.4:3.2: na kho pana samaṇa passāma bhoto gotamassa yugaṃ vā naṅgalaṃ vā phālaṃ vā pāpanaṃ vā balibaddhe vā
snp1.4:3.3: atha ca pana bhavaṃ gotamo evamāha
snp1.4:3.4: ahampi kho brāhmaṇa kasāmi ca vappāmi ca kasitvā ca vappitvā ca bhuñjāmīti.
snp1.4:4.1: atha kho kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
snp1.4:10.1: atha kho kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo mahatiyā kaṃsapātiyā pāyāsaṃ vaḍḍhetvā bhagavato upanāmesi
snp1.4:10.4: yañhi bhavaṃ gotamo amatapphalaṃ kasiṃ kasatīti.
snp1.4:13.1: atha kassa cāhaṃ bho gotama imaṃ pāyāsaṃ dammīti.
snp1.4:13.2: na khvāhaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇa passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yena so pāyāso bhutto sammā pariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya aññatra tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā
snp1.4:13.3: tena hi tvaṃ brāhmaṇa taṃ pāyāsaṃ appaharite vā chaḍḍehi appāṇake vā udake opilāpehīti.
snp1.4:14.1: atha kho kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo taṃ pāyāsaṃ appāṇake udake opilāpesi.
snp1.4:14.2: atha kho so pāyāso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati saṃdhūmāyati sampadhūmāyati.
snp1.4:14.3: seyyathāpi nāma ayogulo divasasantatto udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati saṃdhūmāyati sampadhūmāyati
snp1.4:14.4: evameva so pāyāso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati saṃdhūmāyati sampadhūmāyati.
snp1.4:15.1: atha kho kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
snp1.4:15.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhik kantaṃ bho gotama.
snp1.4:15.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
snp1.4:15.4: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ.
snp1.4:15.5: labheyyāhaṃ bhoto gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
snp1.4:16.1: alattha kho kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
snp1.4:16.2: acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā bhāradvājo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva āgārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
snp1.4:16.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
snp1.4:16.4: aññataro kho panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosīti.
